arguments.text: Stage 3 retry semantics are edge-scoped: only an edge with retry=true requires attempts. The request attempts value must have exact Python type int (bool is rejected), be >=0, and be less than an integer policy retry_limit. Role denial is evaluated before retry validity. Local boundary checks passed for missing attempts, bool, -1, 0, limit-1, limit, and attempts on a non-retry edge; inputs remained unchanged.

Unresolved limits: malformed non-mapping request/policy/edges/edge values are outside the task contract and untested. retry_limit validity is only relevant on retry=true edges. No evidence.json is present, so report.json is derived solely from requests.json and policy.json.
